{{Quote|The Desolation Station facility is where components are assembled prior to being transported to the Death Star construction site itself.|Rahm Kota|<ref name="Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron">''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron]]''</ref>}}
'''Desolation Station''' was an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]]-based [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] facility that was used to assemble and transport [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]] components to the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]]. Commanded by an Imperial [[Desolation Station's commander|captain]] and overseen by the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[X1]], the facility became the target of a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Mission to Desolation Station|raid]] at some point between [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] and [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. Alliance agent [[X2]], assisted by a small group of Rebels, infiltrated the facility, rescued [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] being held there, and deactivated the [[shield corridor]] protecting a [[Transport/Legends|transport]] carrying the last of the superlaser components, the [[tributary beam]]. After securing the transport itself, X2 used the tributary beam to destroy Desolation Station.

==Description==
{{Quote|X2, we've received reports that there are Wookiees being held captive on board Desolation Station. Their holding quarters are directly west of your current location. There's less resistance on the east path though&mdash;if you're getting overwhelmed by enemy forces, then that might be an easier route to the control room.|Rahm Kota briefs X2 on the station's layout|<ref name="Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron" />}}
Desolation Station was a construction facility operated by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the early [[Standard day/Legends|days]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. The facility was built on the surface of a large, misshapen [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] within an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]]<ref name="BF: ES" /> in a [[Desolation Station system|star system]] located in the [[Atrivis sector/Legends|Atrivis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]].<ref name="Region" /> Desolation Station's primary purpose was the construction of [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]] components for the Imperial [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] project, which itself was being assembled near the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Despayre]]<ref name="BF: ES" /> in the nearby [[Horuz system/Legends|Horuz system]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Once completed, the components were loaded onto armed [[Transport/Legends|transports]] that delivered them to the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]]. The transports were protected by a defensive [[Deflector shield/Legends|shield]] corridor that connected the facility to the Death Star construction site. The shield corridor was projected by Desolation Station, and the shield controls were located in a special section inside the facility.<ref name="BF: ES" />

The facility also doubled as a [[Prison/Legends|penal colony]], possessing an area containing holding cells for a number of [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]], such as several [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] being held aboard the [[Space station/Legends|station]] shortly prior to its destruction. In addition to the shield control section and the holding cells, the facility had at least two [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] bays, one of which served as a combat station for the facility's complement of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]]. Desolation Station's corridors were filled with various types of machinery and [[Computer/Legends|computers]]. Heavy [[Blast door/Legends|blast doors]] separated different areas of the facility, while [[Ray shield/Legends|ray shields]] protected the exits from the station to the surface of the asteroid.<ref name="BF: ES" /> The station had a [[Life support/Legends|life support]] system capable of maintaining [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] breathable to [[Human/Legends|Humans]],<ref name="Life support" /> as well as an intruder detection system capable of putting the entire facility in a state of high alert in case of a security breach. Multiple [[Bacta tank/Legends|bacta tanks]] and weapons caches were spread throughout Desolation Station, in addition to a number of [[E-Web heavy repeating blaster/Legends|E-Web heavy repeating blaster]] positions.<ref name="BF: ES" />

==History==
{{Quote|Nicely done, boy! That should give us a serious edge over the Empire's production time! The Rebel Alliance may have use for a scrapper like you yet. Return to base and we'll see about getting you formally initiated.|Rahm Kota, to X2|<ref name="Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron" />}}
[[File:Desolation_Station_destroyed.jpg|thumb|left|240px|Desolation Station's destruction]]
Desolation Station had been in operation by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the latter stages of the construction of the first Death Star.<ref name="BF: ES" /> At some point between [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] and [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="Dates" /> the final component of the Death Star's superlaser, the [[tributary beam]], was assembled at the facility and prepared for transport to the Death Star's construction site in the Horuz [[Star system/Legends|system]]. During that time, the facility was commanded by an Imperial [[Desolation Station's commander|captain]], who in turn answered to [[X1]], a high-ranking [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] who was overseeing the project away from the facility. In its [[Operation Skyhook|effort]] to destroy the Death Star, the Rebel Alliance learned about the existence of the facility and the transportation of the tributary beam that was supposed to take place. A lone Rebel agent named [[X2]], X1's brother and a recent recruit into the Alliance by way of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]], was dispatched to stop the Imperial operation. Following a plan developed by Kota, X2 [[Mission to Desolation Station|infiltrated]] the facility itself, landing in one of its hangars. [[Gender/Legends|He]] was then informed of a number of Wookiee prisoners being held there, awaiting transportation to Despayre.<ref name="BF: ES" />

After liberating the Wookiees, X2 reached the shield control center and deactivated the defensive corridor protecting the transport carrying the tributary beam. Assisted by a number of Rebel agents sent as his reinforcements, X2 reached the TIE fighter combat station and stole one of the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] to escape the facility. At that point, a number of Rebel [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing fighters]] dispatched by Kota arrived to assist X2. Fighting through the [[TIE series/Legends|TIE]] fighters launched from the station to intercept him, X2 flew to the transport, destroyed its [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] defenses, infiltrated it, and defeated all Imperial opposition aboard. Reaching the tributary beam controls aboard the transport, he then used the beam to destroy Desolation Station itself, although some personnel, including the station's commander, had been able to escape prior to its destruction. The surviving commander was subsequently brought before X1, who [[Death/Legends|executed]] him for his incompetence. The destruction of Desolation Station served as a major setback in the construction of the Death Star and bought the Rebellion more time in its campaign to stop the [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]]. The Death Star was eventually finished nonetheless but was later destroyed by the Alliance at the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="BF: ES" />

==Commanders and crew==
[[File:Desolation_Station_commander.jpg|thumb|right|180px|The commanding officer of Desolation Station]]
{{Quote|You will need to locate the controls for the shield corridor. Knowing how the Empire operates, you can be assured they will be well defended.|Rahm Kota, in his briefing to X2|<ref name="Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron" />}}
In the days prior to its destruction, Desolation Station was commanded by an Imperial captain, who escaped from the station, only to be executed later by X1. The facility had a large number of Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] stationed aboard and was generally considered to be well defended, especially the areas near the holding cells.<ref name="BF: ES" />

==Behind the scenes==
Desolation Station first appeared in the [[2009]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron]]'', which featured its destruction. It appeared exclusively in the [[Wikipedia:Nintendo DS|Nintendo DS]] version of the game, developed by [[N-Space|N-space]], in the second level of the game's Act II.<ref name="BF: ES" />
